description: Calls eth_call against the latest block to preview the outcome of a transaction. Returns raw return data on success, or the decoded revert reason on failure. Useful before approving a swap, contract call, or bridge to confirm it won't revert.

from.description: Sender address. Defaults to the authenticated wallet, then to zero.

network.description: Monad network — "mainnet" or "testnet". Defaults to the server's configured network.

name: simulate_transaction
title: Dry-run a transaction (eth_call)
